# Last Actor task run's default dataset

The API endpoints described in this section are convenience endpoints that provide access to Actor task's last run's default dataset without the need to resolve the dataset ID first.

Subset of functionality described in: [Datasets](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/storage-datasets.md)

<!-- -->

## [Get last task run's default dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-dataset-get.md)

[/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/runs/last/dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-dataset-get.md)

## [Update last task run's default dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-dataset-put.md)

[/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/runs/last/dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-dataset-put.md)

## [Delete last task run's default dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-dataset-delete.md)

[/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/runs/last/dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-dataset-delete.md)

## [Get last task run's dataset items](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-dataset-items-get.md)

[/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/runs/last/dataset/items](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-dataset-items-get.md)
